changelog: Chat window in 9 more languages: German, French, Spanish, Italian, Dutch, Portuguese, Japanese, Korean and Simplified Chinese
Multilingual sites (Polylang, WPML): the chat window and its messages follow each page's language
Help & diagnostics: copy or download a diagnostics report (no API keys or visitor data) and email support in one click
Larger close and menu buttons on phones; no double space in the lead confirmation when no name is given
聊天視窗新增 9 種語言（德、法、西、義、荷、葡、日、韓、簡中），多語系網站跟著每頁語言；設定頁新增「說明與診斷」一鍵複製診斷資訊；手機標頭按鈕加大
